name: Open Home Page
expected: Website loads with HTTP 200 & portal branding
actual: Status 200, Title: "StudentHub — Integrated Student Management Portal | CHARUSAT CSPIT"
remarks: Home page with dynamic metrics and institutional branding loaded correctly

name: Navigation
expected: All navigation links are valid and present
remarks: Navigation bar routes to Home, About Us, Features, Campus Events, and Helpdesk

name: About Page
expected: Displays project specifications & student details
remarks: About page displays developer credentials 25CS057 and Practical 1-14 matrix

name: Student Registration
expected: Valid registration is saved to MySQL
remarks: New student account created with Bcrypt password hash and audit log entry

name: Duplicate Registration
expected: Duplicate entry is rejected by server
remarks: Prepared statement duplicate email/username check prevented duplicate record insertion

name: Student Login
expected: Student dashboard opens upon successful login
remarks: Student redirected to student_dashboard.php with attendance, timetable, and registrations

name: Admin Login
expected: Admin dashboard opens upon admin authentication
remarks: Admin authenticated and routed to admin_dashboard.php with live database KPIs

name: Invalid Login
expected: Proper error message appears for wrong credentials
remarks: System rejected invalid credentials without disclosing account existence

name: Student Access to Admin Page
expected: Access is denied with HTTP 403
remarks: Server-side RBAC intercepted student request, returned 403 Forbidden, and logged attempt

name: Admin Student Management
expected: Authorized operations work (Table + Add Student)
remarks: Student Management module loaded via Fetch API with full administrative controls

name: Event Management
expected: Event operations console displays active campus events
remarks: Event management console queried events table and rendered cards with poster artwork

name: Poster Upload
expected: File input with validation controls is functional
remarks: Poster upload validates MIME type (JPEG/PNG/WEBP) and enforces 2MB size ceiling

name: Fetch API
expected: Correct JSON response structure is returned
remarks: RESTful /api/records.php returned standard JSON schema with total count and records list

name: AJAX CRUD
expected: Supported search and filter operations work without page reload
remarks: DOM dynamically updated to display filtered student records without full-page refresh

name: Session Timeout
expected: Inactive session triggers timeout alert and invalidation
remarks: Session inactivity handler enforces 15-minute threshold and redirects with security notice

name: Logout
expected: Session is destroyed and user redirected to login
remarks: Session data cleared, cookie revoked, and logout event recorded to audit trail

name: Audit Logs
expected: Relevant administrative and security activities are recorded
remarks: System recorded authentication events, registrations, and RBAC denials without passwords

name: Database
expected: Data is stored and retrieved correctly from MySQL
remarks: Relational schema maintains integrity across users, students, events, registrations, and audit logs

name: Responsive Layout
expected: Website layout adapts seamlessly to mobile screens
remarks: CSS Grid, Flexbox, and media queries gracefully reflow elements on mobile viewports

name: Protected URLs
expected: Unauthorized guest access is prevented and redirected
remarks: requireAuth() guard intercepted unauthenticated access and safely redirected to login
